review_notes: I read the whole file and the uses of localizedMode, localizedPotential and splitLaplacian in the rest of OneParticle/ and ManyBody/. The file has no @[simp] declarations and no simp-set interactions. I found no rewrite cycles, competing rules or bad orientations. The only issue I can support is that the definitions have no equation lemma, so downstream proofs unfold them by hand. I did not find any use that would clearly benefit from simp attributes on the splitLaplacian or localizedPotential definitions. I could not run Lean, so I make no claim about how the simplifier behaves. Whether to tag the suggested lemma @[simp] is a judgement call. The unfold-by-hand pattern is the stronger evidence.

findings.problem: localizedMode and localizedPotential are plain defs with no equation lemma, so every caller unfolds them by hand. This file does so with `simp_rw [localizedMode, mul_pow]` (twice), `simp only [localizedMode]`, `simp only [localizedMode, deriv_const_mul_field', ...]` and a `change` that restates the body. The same pattern recurs in SplitProjectionPairing (`unfold localizedMode`, twice), LocalizedTransition (`unfold localizedMode`), LocalizedHigherMoments and LocalizedDensityMoment (`simp only [localizedMode,sub_zero,mul_pow,Pi.add_apply]`), and LocalizedCoulombTranslation and LocalizedCoulombRadial. LocalizedOneBody does `unfold localizedPotential at he`. Unfolding the definition exposes the `p.1`/`p.2` projections, so each proof has to handle them again. There is also no `(r, z)`-form lemma to feed to simp for expressions like `localizedMode freq u (r, p.2)`. That form appears inside `splitLaplacian` and in `localizedMode_planar_laplacian`, which is why the latter needs a `change`.
findings.proposed_change: Add canonical equation lemmas right after the definitions, for example `theorem localizedMode_apply (freq u p) : localizedMode freq u p = normalizedPlanarMode (p.1 - u) * verticalMode freq p.2 := rfl` and `theorem localizedMode_mk (freq u r z) : localizedMode freq u (r, z) = normalizedPlanarMode (r - u) * verticalMode freq z := rfl`. Add the analogous `localizedPotential_apply` lemmas. Then use them in place of `unfold` and `change`. The pair form `localizedMode_mk` can be made @[simp] with no looping risk, because its right-hand side mentions neither `localizedMode` nor the pair. Its left-hand side is a fixed constructor pattern, and the lemma's only effect is to expand the definition at an explicit pair. The projection form could be left non-simp and used through `simp only` or `rw`.
findings.benefit: Callers can use `simp only [localizedMode_apply]` or `rw [localizedMode_mk]` instead of `unfold`/`change` against the raw definition. Proofs such as `localizedMode_planar_laplacian` and `localizedMode_vertical_second` no longer need a `change` to reach the product form. The product normal form is stated once and named, so later files do not each re-derive it.
